problemStatement.plain: The classical Mean Value Theorem equality f'(c) = slope does NOT generalize to vector-valued functions. Instead, we have the Mean Value Inequality: if the derivative norm is bounded by C, then the displacement is bounded by C times the interval length.

Correct generalization of MVT to infinite dimensions
